summary: Iteration-5: Interactive in-app Install Guide (/install public route) + local-disk storage regression. Backend 4/4 passed (PDF static, /install SPA, upload→download roundtrip x2). Frontend UI: 11/11 checks passed (unauth /install loads, 3x OsTabs render with 9 copy buttons, tab clicks swap content, groups are isolated, Download PDF href, Back-to-Orb, Auth → /install link navigation).
action_items: (MINOR/optional) In InstallGuide.jsx CodeBlock.copy(), append .catch() to navigator.clipboard.writeText(...) — headless / permission-denied contexts currently raise an unhandled rejection that CRA's dev overlay surfaces (no impact on real browsers or production build, but the dev overlay is noisy during automation).
critical_code_review_comments: InstallGuide.jsx is well-structured (CodeBlock, Section, OsTabs sub-components). Public route correctly placed OUTSIDE <Protected> in App.js (line 42), confirmed to load without redirecting to /login while unauthenticated.

3 OsTabs groups (Prerequisites, Start MongoDB, Install backend) — each Tabs instance carries its own state, group isolation verified end-to-end: switching Prereqs to Linux then MongoDB to macOS keeps Prereqs on Linux.
guide-copy-button has opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 — exists in DOM so testable, and visible to users on hover. Good a11y compromise.
navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(...) lacks a .catch — unhandled promise rejection in environments where clipboard write is denied (headless, insecure contexts). Trivial fix.
guide-download-pdf points to /instruction.pdf served from frontend/public — verified 200 + application/pdf + valid %PDF magic + 10KB.

Auth.jsx footer auth-install-guide-link uses plain <a href='/install'> — triggers full page reload rather than client-side route. Acceptable here (separate marketing-style flow), but could be <Link to='/install'> for snappier UX.
Local-disk storage refactor (STORAGE_DIR, put_object/get_object in server.py) works end-to-end: POST /api/upload → /api/files/{path} byte-for-byte roundtrip verified for both binary and text uploads.
server.py still ~1370 lines, single module. Same long-standing recommendation: split into routers. Not blocking.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/iteration5_test.py (new — 4 tests: PDF served, /install SPA, upload+download roundtrip binary, upload+download text)
test_credentials: admin@promethius.ai / Fire2026! (password login API used to obtain JWT for upload regression)
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_-prefixed uploads (TEST_iter5.bin, TEST_iter5.txt) written under STORAGE_DIR/promethius/uploads/<admin-id>/<uuid>.<ext>. Not auto-deleted (no DELETE /api/files endpoint exists). Negligible disk impact (~200 bytes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Five backend test suites now: backend_test.py (regression ~12s), iteration2_test.py (advanced abilities ~110s), iteration3_test.py (orb-mode), iteration4_test.py (directives/speakers/per-person memory), iteration5_test.py (install guide static + upload roundtrip, ~1.5s). Frontend: /install is PUBLIC — no auth required. Three OsTabs groups on the page; each os-tab-{windows,macos,linux} testid appears 3x. Use indexed query_selector_all + .click(force=True) to address individual groups. guide-copy-button is opacity-0 until hover but always in DOM. Headless clipboard writes throw — wrap in try/except or just verify click does not error.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The user's original complaint ('PDF tabs are not clickable, key data missing') is fully resolved: tabs are now REAL clickable React Tabs that swap content per-group, all .env variables are shown in a syntax-highlighted CodeBlock (no truncation), and the PDF is still downloadable as a fallback. Only suggestion: add .catch on clipboard promise to silence dev-mode unhandled-rejection overlay during headless automation.
